comments.author: hunterhoke
comments.content: For many years, Quest has been completely inaccessible with screen readers, meaning the totally blind and visually impaired have not been able to use the player and editor. This is also true of Squiffy. Is there a chance that this could change in the next update?  If you need someone to test Quest and/or  for accessibility issues, feel free to contact me. I’d be more than willing to help out in any way.

comments.author: pixiemusingsblog
comments.content: I am sorry about that. I was under the impression Quest had something built in to facilitate that (called JAWS). That said, another user has pointed out an issue with the editor with this version with a Braille reader (are you talking about creating games or playing games or both?), so I am aware there is some issue here, and I am hoping to get it resolved (that said, my knowledge of the underlying systems may not be up to it yet).
